translated_title: Sheinbaum Believes the UN Is Overwhelmed; Points to Palestine, Iran, Cuba, and Venezuela as Examples

meta_description: Sheinbaum questioned a Security Council where five countries hold the veto, and explained why she chose not to attend this year's General Assembly.
